announcements.title: JET Pilot 2.0 is here
announcements.body: A Clusters hub for every cluster you have, sign-in to AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and six more clouds right in the app, and guardrails for production. Install it when JET Pilot offers the update, or download it from [jet-pilot.app](https://www.jet-pilot.app).

announcements.title: Help others find JET Pilot
announcements.body: JET Pilot is free, open source and made in spare time. If it's useful to you, a star on GitHub or telling a colleague about it helps other people find it. Thank you!
